original_record.question: The right pyramid shown has a square base and all eight of its edges are the same length. What is the degree measure of angle $ABD$?<image1>
original_record.subject: solid geometry

inventory: Square pyramid apex A, base B-C-D-E; five solid edges and three hidden edges meeting E; five labels; no dots or angle arcs.
explicit_conditions: Right square pyramid, all eight edges equal.
layout_choices: Unit scale; apex height sqrt(1/2); base diagonal BD not added.

answer_check.reasoning: Triangle ABD has AB=AD=s and BD=s√2; cosine at B is BD/(2s)=1/√2 so angle ABD=45°.
